<thought>Propose the SMILES for ethyl 3,4‑dihydroxybenzoate, which matches the observed NMR (ester carbonyl, aromatic ring, O‑CH₂‑CH₃) and has formula C9H10O4 (neutral mass ≈182.058 Da, giving [M+H]⁺ ≈183.066 Da, close to the observed 183.045). The SMILES is `CCOC(=O)C1=CC(O)=C(O)C=C1`.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=CC(O)=C(O)C=C1</final_answer>
